turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hi Leander! To check your order, please send me the order number (like SC-1234) and the email address used for the order.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.

I'm sorry, but I can't look up orders by name. To share any order details, I need both the order number and the email used for the order. If you find them later, send them here and I'll check right away.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.

I'm sorry, but I can't share the delivery address or any order status, or say whether an order exists, until you're verified. For that I need the order number and the email used for the order. Once you have both, send them here and I'll check right away.
